purpose: Evaluation only. Never import or read this file from the runtime analyzer.

evaluation_rule_contract.R1: Five or more distinct 4625 events within an inclusive five-minute rolling window grouped by hostname, target_domain, target_user and source_ip, not logon_type. Merge qualifying windows sharing a failure into one episode retaining their union of supporting records.
evaluation_rule_contract.R2: A 4624 strictly after the final R1 failure and no more than ten minutes later, matching R1 grouping fields and the final failed logon's non-null logon_type. Assign to nearest compatible episode, then choose the earliest success per episode. Supporting IDs include failures and selected success.
evaluation_rule_contract.R3: One or more 4698 events strictly after the selected R2 success and no more than fifteen minutes later, same host and subject account/domain matching the success target, matching nonzero session IDs, and no visible intervening reuse. Aggregate matching tasks per success. Supporting IDs include failures, success, and every matching task; task source_ip is not required.
